thread:
olivia: Heads up — noticed a surge in negative invoice adjustments for AWS reseller accounts after we flipped the Q1 pricing experiment. ~120 credits flagged overnight, appears tied to partner discount override. Anyone seeing this?

sam: Yep saw it. Billing alert picked up 118 credit memos in the us-east reseller pool. Looks like `reseller_discount_pct` was applied twice in the billing pipeline. Investigating.

harry: Can you paste an example invoice line? I'm pulling ledger rows now.

sam: Example (sanitized):
```
invoice: 98321 | partner: cloudedge | sku: RW-RES-AWS-BASE | qty: 1 | list_usd: 500.00 | partner_discount: -75.00 | promo_adjustment: -75.00 | net_usd: 350.00
```
That `promo_adjustment` is the experiment delta — shouldn't stack with partner_discount.

marta: @olivia tagging Partner Success — partners will see unexpected credits on their billing statements, want to pre-empt outreach. :eyes: Do we hold collections?

olivia: Hold on collections for impacted partners. Sam/Harry, estimate count + gross credit amount so we can draft an internal note and partner comms. Also get a rollback plan for the experiment flag.

sam: Running a query now across invoices/lineitems. Preliminary numbers: 118 credits, total ~$8.9k. Will upload CSV to the finance drive in 10m.

harry: If it's a pipeline double-apply, we should publish a rollback PR and run a recompute job for affected invoice range. I can execute ledger re-run once we have exact invoice ids — need finance sign-off for adjustments and a maintenance window.

olivia: I'll approve manual credits up to $10k for immediate fixes but want the audit trail (who approved, reason). Keep @legal out for now unless partner escalates.

marta: I'll start a short partner-facing note template. Sam — can you include partner contact column in the CSV? That'll help prioritization.

billing-bot: Alert: invoice-recalc job queued by harry; ETA ~14m. job-id: jr_2026_04_01_33

sam: Added report: https://drive.redwood/finance/q1-pricing-credit-report (placeholder) — CSV filename `q1_reseller_credits_1988887777.csv`, includes invoice_id, partner_id, contact_email, credit_amount_usd, discovered_by.

olivia: Great. Once final numbers confirmed, ping me and I'll sign off for the ledger adjustments and the rollback. Thanks everyone — let's keep this thread for status updates only.
notes: Issue caused by experiment flag applying additional partner discount on top of existing partner discount in billing pipeline. Finance approved ad-hoc credits up to $10k pending audit trail. Action items: recompute invoices, rollback experiment flag, notify partners with drafted comms.
